title.zh: 将伊洛伊洛省若干职业中学改设为国立综合中学并授权为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Converting Certain Vocational High Schools in the Province of Ilo-Ilo Into National Comprehensive High Schools and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Converting Certain Vocational High Schools in the Province of Ilo-Ilo Into National Comprehensive High Schools and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_5710_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
The following vocational high schools in the Province of Hoilo are hereby converted into national comprehensive high schools:
The Alimodian National Vocational High School in the Municipality of Alimodian, Province of Iloilo, to be known as Alimodian National Comprehensive High School.
The Sta. Barbara National Vocational High School in the Municipality of Sta. Barbara, Province of Iloilo, to be known as Santa Barbara National Comprehensive High School.
Comprehensive curriculum which includes academic, industrial arts, ceramics, electricity, handicrafts and other allied courses shall be offered. The Secretary of Education is hereby empowered to reorganize the said schools accordingly.
Upon organization of the new schools, the assets, liabilities, personnel, equipment and records of the old schools shall stand transferred to the new national comprehensive high schools.

In addition to the present appropriations for said schools, the sum of three hundred thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to carry out the purposes of this Act for the fiscal year nineteen hundred and sixty-nine, which shall be equally shared by the Alimodian National Comprehensive High School and the Sta. Barbara National Comprehensive High School. Thereafter, such sums as may be needed for their operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted without Executive approval, June 21, 1969.
